productOnPage.title: The Laurie Berkner Collection
productOnPage.author: The Laurie Berkner Band
productOnPage.description: Yoto Says: Loved by parents and kids around the world, Laurie Berkner and her band have curated three themed cards for Yoto of some of their favourite songs. Rock along with award-winning children’s music artist Laurie Berkner and her band in this collection curated just for Yoto! Featuring three jam-tastic albums, this pack is sure to have the whole family dancing along.Laurie Berkner has sold over 1.1 million albums since her start in 1992. With 10 award-winning albums, critics widely acknowledge Laurie’s major contribution to launching what is now dubbed the progressive “kindie rock” movement.This collection includes:Laurie Berkner’s Animal SongsLaurie Berkner’s Food SongsLaurie Berkner’s Transportation Songs Tracks included: Rocketship Run The Airplane Song Fast and Slow (The Rabbit and the Turtle) Drive My Car Magic Box Trucks One More Stop on the Train Pillowland Blow a Kiss
productOnPage.descriptionHtml:
Rock along with award-winning children’s music artist Laurie Berkner and her band in this collection curated just for Yoto! Featuring three jam-tastic albums, this pack is sure to have the whole family dancing along.


Laurie Berkner has sold over 1.1 million albums since her start in 1992. With 10 award-winning albums, critics widely acknowledge Laurie’s major contribution to launching what is now dubbed the progressive “kindie rock” movement.


This collection includes:

Laurie Berkner’s Animal Songs

Laurie Berkner’s Food Songs

Laurie Berkner’s Transportation Songs
productOnPage.descriptionMarkdown:
**_Yoto Says: Loved by parents and kids around the world, Laurie Berkner and her band have curated three themed cards for Yoto of some of their favourite songs._**

Rock along with award-winning children’s music artist Laurie Berkner and her band in this collection curated just for Yoto! Featuring three jam-tastic albums, this pack is sure to have the whole family dancing along.  
  
  
  
  
Laurie Berkner has sold over 1.1 million albums since her start in 1992. With 10 award-winning albums, critics widely acknowledge Laurie’s major contribution to launching what is now dubbed the progressive “kindie rock” movement.  
  
  
  
  
This collection includes:  
  
Laurie Berkner’s Animal Songs  
  
Laurie Berkner’s Food Songs  
  
Laurie Berkner’s Transportation Songs

Tracks included:

*   Rocketship Run
*   The Airplane Song
*   Fast and Slow (The Rabbit and the Turtle)
*   Drive My Car
*   Magic Box
*   Trucks
*   One More Stop on the Train
*   Pillowland
*   Blow a Kiss

Creators are independent audio makers bringing their original stories, games, songs and more to Yoto Cards. We hand-pick the best and freshest ideas — so every Creators Card meets the Yoto gold standard.
